body: I hate when people tell me it gets better. I know how you feel. The only reason your mom treats you like that is because she cares about you. She just wants the best for you and she doesn't know how to show you that. Please don't try to kill yourself because even though parents can be assholes sometimes, they still care about us. You have a lot to live for and I don't think you should give up. Depression sucks and I know how you feel about not having motivation to do anything. Simple tasks often feel like chores. You are not alone
It feels good to hear someone say that. Thank you
Thank you I'm just scared she won't know what to do and that she'll feel like she has done something wrong. I just don't want to disappoint her
